resources.string: Your tasks and rewards stay on this phone. Every world and navigation feature is available from the start.
Complete your first quest to earn First step.
Opens after %1$d completed quests. %2$d completed so far.
Each quest earns 20 XP. Finishing its focus timer of at least 10 minutes adds 10 XP once. No streaks to maintain, and no points to lose for taking your time.
App updates preserve your quests. Uninstalling Waypoint removes them. There is no account or cloud backup.
Five small promises, kept. The map has not changed, but your place in it has. Every journey begins with something ordinary that you decide to do.
The familiar paths now carry a different story: the things you finished, the time you made, the people and places you chose. You are drawing a route of your own.
Fifty quests behind you, and no final destination to chase. Take a moment to look back. The next chapter can be as small as a quiet afternoon or as wide as a new horizon.
